map.按 Arrhenius 热降解模型与应力因子，估算高性能工程材料在工况下的使用寿: Estimate the service life of high-performance engineering materials under working conditions by the Arrhenius thermal degradation model and stress factor
map.基于阿伦尼乌斯热老化模型：高性能材料寿命 L 随工作温度 T 指数衰减，由活化能: Based on the Arrhenius thermal aging model: high-performance material life L decays exponentially with operating temperature T, computed from activation energy Ea, reference temperature Tr and base life Lr, for high-temperature environment life estimation.
map.💡 Arrhenius: L=Lr×exp[Ea/R×(1/T-1/Tr)]；应: Arrhenius: L = Lr times exp[Ea / R times (1 / T minus 1 / Tr)]; stress factor: exp[minus beta times (sigma / sigma max)]; R = 8.314 J / (mol K)
map.PEEK长期耐温260℃，PI耐温300℃以上，PTFE耐温260℃: PEEK long-term temperature resistance 260 C, PI above 300 C, PTFE 260 C
map.活化能 Ea 越大，材料对温度越敏感，高温寿命下降越快: The larger the activation energy Ea, the more temperature-sensitive the material and the faster the high-temperature life declines
map.应力因子中 β 通常取 3~10，反映应力加速老化程度: In the stress factor beta is usually 3 to 10, reflecting the stress acceleration of aging
map.📚 深度解析：高分子材料寿命预测（Arrhenius 温度+应力因子）: In-depth: Polymer Material Life Prediction (Arrhenius temperature + stress factor)
map.评估：按使用温度与应力相对参考条件预测寿命: assessment: predict life by operating temperature and stress relative to reference conditions
map.加速老化外推：由高温高应力试验外推常温寿命: Accelerated aging extrapolation: extrapolate normal-temperature life from high-temperature high-stress tests
map.选材与工况优化：温度/应力超限时提示换料: Material and condition optimization: prompt material change when temperature / stress exceeds limit
map.温度因子=exp[Ea/R×(1/Tk−1/Trk)]（Ea 活化能 J/mol: Temperature factor = exp[Ea / R times (1 / Tk minus 1 / Trk)] (Ea activation energy J/mol, R = 8.314, Tk / Trk are Kelvin operating / reference temperatures); stress factor = exp[minus 5 times load / max stress]; estLife = reference life times temperature factor times stress factor; life grade: greater than or equal to 50000 excellent, greater than or equal to 10000 good, greater than or equal to 1000 medium, otherwise poor.
map.t=200℃、载荷 50、Ea=120 kJ/mol、参考 150℃、参考寿命: t = 200 C, load 50, Ea = 120 kJ/mol, reference 150 C, reference life 100000 h, sigma max = 200: temperature factor 0.0272, stress factor 0.2865, estLife about 779.3 h (poor, degradation 7.79e2 %/h), temperature ratio 1.33, stress ratio 25%; 200 C exceeds material limit, need to change material.
map.Arrhenius 温度因子为什么可能远小于 1？: Why can the Arrhenius temperature factor be far less than 1?
map.使用温度高于参考温度时 1/Tk<1/Trk，指数为负，温度因子<1 表示寿命大: When the operating temperature is higher than the reference temperature, 1 / Tk is less than 1 / Trk, the exponent is negative, the temperature factor is less than 1 meaning life is greatly shortened; in this example 200 C is 50 C higher than the reference 150 C, the factor is only 0.027, life shrinks to about 1 / 37.
map.应力因子里的 5 是什么？: What is the 5 in the stress factor?
map.β=5 为应力敏感度经验系数，载荷越接近最大应力 σmax，应力因子越小（寿命越: beta = 5 is the stress sensitivity empirical coefficient; the closer the load is to the maximum stress sigma max, the smaller the stress factor (shorter life); sigma / sigma max = 25% gives factor about 0.287.
map.关于「高性能材料寿命」: About the High-Performance Material Life tool
map.高性能材料寿命计算器基于 Arrhenius 热降解动力学模型与应力加速老化因子: The high-performance material life calculator is based on the Arrhenius thermal degradation kinetic model and stress acceleration aging factor, inputs operating temperature, working load and material parameters (activation energy, reference temperature, base life), estimates the service life of PEEK, PI, PPS, PTFE, carbon fiber composite and engineering ceramic under working conditions.
